subject: Hosted evaluation: sandbox traffic slice, endpoints & runbook
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted evaluation: sandbox traffic slice, endpoints & runbook

Hi Liam — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from today's demo and the proposed path for a hosted dry run so we can validate latency, cost, and reliability before you commit to a Dedicated pool or Private VPC.

Summary of recommendation
- Hosted API looks like the most frictionless path for your first phase. It meets the latency targets you described for the majority of requests and gives us the quickest way to validate traffic patterns.
- If Finlytics expects sustained 500+ rps with >200 tokens/request for production, we should revisit Dedicated capacity (predictable throughput) or Private (VPC) for compliance needs.

What we need from you
- Target concurrency and expected average tokens/request (sample: 120 tokens/request, 300 rps).
- Top-3 endpoints you'd exercise and whether they require streaming or structured outputs.
- Any hard SLOs (p95 latency < 250ms, etc.) or regulatory constraints.

Proposed dry-run (sandbox) runbook — three phases
1) Smoke (2 hours): single endpoint, 10 rps, validate auth + responses + KV caching behavior.
2) Traffic slice (1 day): scale to ~25% of target traffic for a sustained 2hr window (we'll monitor p95, token cost, error rates).
3) Ramp & soak (1–2 days): bring to ~75–100% of planned peak for short windows, validate fallbacks and auto-throttle.

Sandbox details we can provision now
- Sandbox endpoints: https://api.redwood.com/hosted/sandbox/v1/{endpoint} (token-based)
- Default sandbox rate limits: 100 rps per endpoint, burst up to 250 for 60s; token-based billing applies.
- Token cache: prefix/KV cache will be enabled for identical prompt prefixes — tell us if you have many unique prefixes.
- Credentials expire by default after 14 days; we can extend to 30 days for this trial.

Attachments: sandbox-access-instructions.pdf (credentials + endpoint mapping), throughput-template.csv (fill avg tokens + expected qps), redwood-hosted-pricing.pdf (hosted pricing bands).

Next steps
- Reply with the three bullets under "What we need from you" and a preferred date window for the slice run (we have availability next Wed/Thu).
- If you'd like us to provision an elevated sandbox ceiling (500 rps for one day) please confirm and we'll loop in infra to grant it.

Thanks — I put Marissa and Neha on Cc to help schedule and assist with test provisioning.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
https://redwood.com

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@finlytics.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation: sandbox traffic slice, endpoints & runbook

Vivek — thanks for the recap and clear runbook. Quick answers below, plus a couple questions.

> What we need from you
- Target concurrency & avg tokens: we'd like to test up to 500 rps for the traffic slice. Typical payloads are ~120 tokens/request (inference only), but our recommendation engine has ~10% heavy requests (~350 tokens).
- Top endpoints: /v1/predict (sync streaming), /v1/rerank (batch), /v1/embed (bulk async).
- SLOs: p95 latency target for predict streaming is 300ms; rerank/batch can be looser (1–2s).

Questions:
1) Can the sandbox be configured to allow 500 rps for a single 4-hour window?
2) Do you support multiple sandbox tokens (one per environment) and a way to rotate them via API?
3) Any guidance on how KV cache behaves with high cardinality user prompts (we'll probably have a lot of unique prefixes)?

Timeline: we'd like to run the slice next Thursday (Jun 29) and then do the ramp/soak the week after. We're targeting an internal go/no-go by mid-July.

Thanks — I copied platform@finlytics so our infra lead can coordinate.

— Liam
Head of Platform, Finlytics
liam@finlytics.com

Team — forwarding Finlytics answers. They want a 4-hour window at 500 rps on Jun 29 for the traffic slice and plan to ramp afterward. Items for infra/eng: 

- Can we grant a temporary elevated sandbox ceiling: 500 rps for a 4-hour window on 2028-06-29 14:00–18:00 UTC?
- Please confirm if we can issue two sandbox tokens (staging & warmup) and an API method to rotate them (they prefer rotation).
- Note the heavy-request mix (~10% at ~350 tokens). Confirm any early warnings we should set (error rate > 1.5% or p95 > 350ms).
- Diego: please review throughput-template.csv (attached) and advise on whether the default prefix/KV cache is likely to provide benefit given high prefix cardinality.

Attachments included for infra: throughput-template.csv (pre-filled with Finlytics estimates).

If infra needs to move the date, tell me earliest alternate window — Finlytics prefers Jun 29 but is flexible by +/- 2 business days.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation: sandbox traffic slice, endpoints & runbook

Liam — confirmed. Quick status and next steps: 

- Infra has tentatively approved the temporary ceiling; final provisioning will be confirmed by EOD next Mon after Diego signs off on the throughput template.
- We'll issue two sandbox tokens (staging, warmup) with 30-day expirations and provide an API snippet for rotation in sandbox-access-instructions.pdf.
- Diego will send a short note on prefix/KV behavior and suggested probe cadence for high-cardinality prompts.
- I'll open a HubSpot activity and attach the docs; Marissa will send the formal test invite with calendaring.

Deliverables we will share before the Jun 29 window
- Elevated sandbox credentials + endpoint mapping (credential email)
- A short runbook for the 4-hour slice with monitoring dashboards and alert triggers
- Post-slice debrief template (latency, error profile, token cost estimate)

Thanks — we appreciate the clear timelines. If anything changes from your side, ping me and Marissa.

Best,
Vivek
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
